description: Repertoire-driven corpus for French gloss expansion. Poems are the primary unit; settings link composers to poems. Schema v1 designed by Claude, reviewed by Kimi (K2.5, Architecture & UX Lead), ratified by Dann Mitton. Schema v2 incorporates Kimi's Stage 3 architectural review: poet-centred harvesting, nullable opus fields, separated integer fields for sorting, cycle metadata, LiederNet ID capture for reproducibility.

harvest_strategy.phase_a: Top 10 poet index pages — target ~60% of Tier A settings via maximum deduplication
harvest_strategy.phase_b: Tier A composer main pages — remaining 30-35%, catches minor poets not in Phase A
harvest_strategy.phase_c: Targeted gap fill — opus-specific searches for composers below 95% coverage

poems.first_line: Я вас любил: любовь ещё, быть может
